pages.title: Security and networking
pages.lead: Azure jobs use Managed Identity. Anonymous storage access and storage shared-key authentication are off. The external Strategy connector stays outside the public repository.

facts.label: Anonymous ADLS
facts.detail: Public users cannot browse or download the raw storage files.

facts.label: Azure jobs
facts.detail: Role-based access writes and reads the required data.

facts.label: External connector
facts.detail: Connector identities and credentials stay outside the public source.

facts.label: Foundry
facts.detail: Agent Consumer and model inference permissions are separate.

flow: Browser can call only the review API
API accepts saved scenarios, not arbitrary prompts
Azure jobs use Managed Identity and data roles
Raw data stays out of the browser
External connector stays outside the public source
Foundry receives only safe evidence and citations
pages.callout: Known gap: public Azure endpoints are still in use. Data access requires Microsoft Entra authorization; anonymous Blob access and storage shared-key access stay disabled.

pages.title: Azure and AI costs
pages.lead: Storage is small. Monitoring, app compute, and live model use are the likely cost drivers. Practice mode makes no paid model call.

facts.label: Budget alert
facts.detail: Alerts are a warning. They do not stop paid resources.

facts.label: Storage
facts.detail: Four current files, a manifest, and dated archives.

facts.label: App compute
facts.detail: Container Apps stays small when the demo is idle.

facts.label: AI
facts.detail: Practice is deterministic and creates no model charge.

pages.callout: No measured monthly total is claimed on this page. Use Azure Cost Management to compare actual spend with this design.
